Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set

Source: R/scenarios.R
simulate_scenario.Rd

Generates one of the master fascicle configurations and returns it as a fiber::bundle_set ready for rtists::plot3d(). Supported configurations:

Usage

simulate_scenario(
  configuration = "bending",
  n_axons = 30,
  angle = 0.5,
  arm_length = 1,
  interaction_length = 2,
  variance = 0.02,
  autocorrelation = 2,
  n_basis = 8,
  n_points = 300L,
  separation = 0.3,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

configuration

One of "bending", "fanning", "merging", "kissing", "crossing".

n_axons

Number of streamlines (per bundle for the two-bundle configurations, or total for "bending" and "fanning").

angle

Bending angle (radians), shared geometry parameter.

arm_length

Length of each bending arm, shared geometry parameter.

interaction_length

Flat interaction length, shared geometry parameter.

variance

Coefficient variance controlling bundle diameter.

autocorrelation

Correlation rate (space between independent and coherent streamlines).

n_basis

Number of B-spline coefficients per coordinate.

n_points

Number of points per centreline after arc-length reparametrization.

separation

Separation between mean pathways for the two-bundle configurations ("merging", "kissing", "crossing").

seed

Optional integer seed for full reproducibility.

Value

A fiber::bundle_set with one (bending, fanning) or two (merging, kissing, crossing) named bundles.

Details

  • "bending": a single bundle whose mean pathway bends (generate_centerline()).

  • "fanning": a single bundle that diverges into two branches after a fork; half the axons follow one branch, half the other (no axon splits).

  • "merging": two bundles that start apart and run together.

  • "kissing": two bundles that meet, travel together, then part.

  • "crossing": two bundles whose mean pathways touch at a point and continue; the streamlines interlace without fusion.

Examples

st <- simulate_scenario("crossing", n_axons = 10, seed = 1)
fiber::is_bundle_set(st)      # TRUE
#> [1] TRUE
st@n_bundles                  # 2
#> [1] 2
